h.name: Shape H
h.descriptor: Shoulders, waist, and hips in a straight line. Pieces that add shape at the waist.
h.principle_1: Add definition at the waist with ties, belts, and seams.
h.principle_2: Wrap and peplum shapes create curve without volume.
h.principle_3: Play with necklines and hems. Your frame carries detail well.

o.name: Shape O
o.descriptor: Fullness through the middle, with great legs and shoulders. Pieces that flow from the shoulder or bust.
o.principle_1: Let fabric fall from the bust or shoulder rather than the waist.
o.principle_2: V and scoop necklines draw the eye upward.
o.principle_3: Show the legs. Above-the-knee hems and slim trousers work well.

v.name: Shape V
v.descriptor: Strong shoulders, narrower hips. Pieces that add volume and detail below the waist.
v.principle_1: Add volume below the waist with full skirts, wide legs, and pleats.
v.principle_2: Keep the shoulder line clean: no puff sleeves or epaulettes.
v.principle_3: Deep V and halter necklines narrow the upper frame.

x.name: Shape X
x.descriptor: Bust and hips in proportion with a defined waist. Pieces that follow the waist rather than skip it.
x.principle_1: Follow the waist: wrap, belted, and fitted-then-flared shapes.
x.principle_2: Boxy cuts that skip the waist lose your best line.
x.principle_3: Fabrics with some drape or stretch hold the shape.

a.name: Shape A
a.descriptor: Hips wider than shoulders. Pieces that bring attention up and skim below.
a.principle_1: Bring attention up with detail at the neckline and shoulder.
a.principle_2: A-line and fluid skirts skim rather than cling.
a.principle_3: Darker, matte fabrics below; texture and colour above.

q1.question: Compared with your hips, your shoulders are…
q1.hint: Think about how a fitted jacket sits, not what you'd change.
q1.a2: About the same as my hips

q2.question: Your waist is…
q2.hint: Relative to your bust and hips.
q2.a1: Clearly narrower than my bust and hips
q2.a2: About the same width as my bust and hips
q2.a3: Fuller than my hips or bust

q3.question: When you gain a little, where does it show first?
q3.hint: Everyone has a place. This only tells us where fabric needs room.

q4.question: Your bust compared with your hips is…

q5.question: Which sounds most familiar?
q5.hint: Pick the one you've said, or thought, in a fitting room.
q5.a1: Jeans that fit my hips gape at the waist
q5.a2: Dresses fit my bust and hips but hang loose at the waist
q5.a3: Fitted waistbands are the first thing to feel tight
q5.a4: Tops fit my shoulders but swim below
q5.a5: Most things fit fairly straight up and down

q6.question: A dress with no waist seam usually…
q6.hint: Think of a shift or a straight column dress.
q6.a1: Hangs straight, which I don't mind
q6.a5: Is the most comfortable thing I own
